newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers stable, low demand.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers stable, low demand.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were mostly stable on Tuesday on low demand totalling only 20,000 tonnes, dealers said.
In both Rotterdam and Antwerp offers for 380 cst bunkers were pegged at around $90 per tonne, although outright buying interest was pegged some $3 a tonne below this level.

Traders said pricing against trans-Atlantic cargoes as part of a regular exchange for sugar deal with Cuba had produced trade as high as $89 a tonne today, but barges for the bunker market had also moved at $87 fob ARA.
Low sulphur 180 cst bunkers talked steady around $95 a tonne.
Hamburg prices held a premiums of around $4 over ARA with 380 cst at $94 and 180 cst at $101 in average to quiet trade.
In the Mediterranean prices at Fos were little changed from Monday with 380 cst at $86 and 180 cst some $6 more.
But Augusta 380 cst firmed about $2 to about $92 with 180 cst up about $1 at $98.
Algeciras 180 cst edged down to $92 with 380 cst at $87 on low demand.
"There has been a lack of enquiry. There is a lot of stock they can't sell, so prices are coming off. It will be a more nervous market tomorrow," one dealer said.
In Piraeus 380 cst was stable at $87 with 180 cst at $95. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
